Pier 3: plain laminated elastomeric bearings (fixed), two under each girder end; effective plan size 300 mm x 400 mm, five internal rubber layers 8 mm thick.
[Design standard] Highway Class I loading (JTG D60-2015); one-way traffic, carriageway width 11.5 m, three design lanes.
